When removed, the stone measured approximately 3.5 centimeters (), and pus and necrotic tissue were found within the gallbladder.
Attention was then turned to the neck of the gallbladder where the anterior wall of the gallbladder was again incised, revealing another a large 4-centimeter stone () that was dissected off the posterior wall and removed.
